title: Reading Drill — Surveying green roofs after storms — Building a comparison
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Surveying green roofs after storms — Building a comparison
passages.body:
**A** The roof inspector had been asked to investigate drains on planted roofs filling with loose material in Bramley. Its first task was to decide which signs of improvement could be compared between sites. It settled on clearing time, because the same measure could be applied in the original setting and at a second location.

**B** During a nine-week comparison, the team used inspection logs at both places. It recorded outcomes separately for each site. Because the steepness of each roof might influence the figures, the team used a column in the record to show when that condition was present. The surveys included quiet periods as well as busy ones.

**C** The team then put forward mesh guards at runoff points. Its report asked for another comparison after the change had been tried. This would distinguish a genuine effect from an improvement that could have occurred anyway. The report did not assume that the more successful site before the change would be the better site afterwards.
